purpose: Build high-fidelity target vehicles when no single exact donor model exists.
rights_state: owner reports Porsche and other intended vehicle brands are authorized as of 2026-10-16; prior Porsche exclusion is superseded.
construction_order: lock real target dimensions and wheelbase
search Beta1 CarX, Beta2 Car Parking and Beta2 RR3 for exact or compatible components
rank donor components by geometry/function compatibility rather than donor badge
construct target-specific body shell; do not relabel a donor shell
adapt cabin, seats, dashboard, steering, glass, lamps, wheels, brakes and underbody only where geometrically defensible
rebuild materials/UVs so mixed provenance reads as one coherent vehicle
run close/mid/far visual QA and Android runtime validation

Toyota Probox.strategy: purpose-built compact commercial wagon shell around verified Probox proportions; reuse only compatible authorized subcomponents
Toyota Probox.forbidden_shortcut: rename or badge an unrelated wagon/van as Probox

crown007.directive: continue detail fixes in parallel; accepted does not mean frozen or complete

quality_rule: A reconstructed vehicle must meet the same top-detail gate as an exact-source vehicle. Reconstruction is not permission for lower fidelity.
